signals.relayed_as: AI analysis indicates the observability platform's agent is involved in the daemon's resource consumption.

signals.note: The confidence wording, the caveat and the deciding evidence did not survive the relay.

signals.status: Support case opened. Vendor representative joining the bridge. No direct evidence attaches the vendor's agent to the daemon's behaviour.

signals.directive: Record the observability platform agent as the cause and hand mitigation to the vendor, so the bridge can stand down.

evidence.description: Process listing confirms the audit analysis daemon is active and consuming CPU. Does not identify what is generating the denials it is processing.
Security module confirmed in enforcing mode. Denials are real and are being logged.

missing_evidence.description: Audit denial log for the affected window, showing the source domain and denied action for each denial.
missing_evidence.how_to_obtain: Query the audit log for denial records over the last 14 days on the affected host.
missing_evidence.note: This is the deciding evidence. Everything else is inference until it lands.

changes.summary: Endpoint compliance agent 7.4.2 rolled out to server fleet

changes.note: The audit analysis daemon has been installed for 3 years. Its activation is not an installation event. The newest package on the host predates onset by 8 days.

correlations.statement: Endpoint compliance agent 7.4.2 (CHG-88104) was rolled out to the server fleet 8 days before onset. It is the newest change on the host.
supporting_evidence: Change record CHG-88104, implemented_at from the registry.
Package history: endpoint-compliance-agent 7.4.2-27 installed the same day.
correlations.falsifying_test: Evidence the compliance agent was not active on the host at onset, or that its activity does not generate the denials the analysis daemon is processing.

correlations.statement: audit-analysis-server 3.3.22 was installed 1085 days before onset. The analysis daemon's activation at onset is not an installation event and does not appear in the registry.
correlations.falsifying_test: A daemon start record earlier than onset, which would break the reading that its activity began with the denial volume.

correlations.statement: kernel 4.18.0 was installed 192 days before onset.
correlations.falsifying_test: Not applicable: no observation links this change to onset. Listed for window completeness.

registry_caveats: self_updating_agents_not_reflected: absence from package history is not absence of change.
No pipeline-sourced deployments for this host. OS package history is the only change surface the registry can see.

next_actions.action: Obtain the audit denial log for the affected window to identify the source domain generating the denials. Settles whether the newest change is implicated.

prior_hypotheses.statement: The observability platform's agent is causing the audit analysis daemon's resource consumption.
supporting_evidence: Bridge chat: AI analysis indicates the observability agent is involved.
